description: This Python source file contains utility functions for parsing and manipulating markdown and HTML documents, including handling code blocks, links, headers, and comments. It is used for processing documentation files, especially for tasks like fixing or comparing documentation content.

classes.name: CodeIncludeInfo
classes.description: TypedDict representing a code include line with line number and content.

classes.name: HeaderPermalinkInfo
classes.description: TypedDict representing a header line with permalink, level, title, and line number.

classes.name: MarkdownLinkInfo
classes.description: TypedDict representing a markdown link with line number, URL, text, title, attributes, and full match.

classes.name: HTMLLinkAttribute
classes.description: TypedDict for HTML link attribute with name, quote type, and value.

classes.name: HtmlLinkInfo
classes.description: TypedDict for HTML link with line number, full tag, attributes, and link text.

classes.name: MultilineCodeBlockInfo
classes.description: TypedDict for multiline code block with language, start line, and content lines.

methods.name: extract_code_includes
methods.description: Extracts lines containing code includes marked by specific syntax.

methods.name: replace_code_includes_with_placeholders
methods.description: Replaces code include lines with placeholders.

methods.name: replace_placeholders_with_code_includes
methods.description: Replaces placeholders with original code include lines, matching counts.

methods.name: extract_header_permalinks
methods.description: Extracts headers with permalinks from document lines.

methods.name: remove_header_permalinks
methods.description: Removes permalinks from header lines.

methods.name: replace_header_permalinks
methods.description: Replaces permalinks in headers with original permalinks, ensuring header level consistency.

methods.name: extract_markdown_links
methods.description: Extracts markdown links from document lines.

methods.name: _add_lang_code_to_url
methods.description: Adjusts URLs to include language code if they start with the base URL.

methods.name: _construct_markdown_link
methods.description: Constructs markdown link syntax with optional language code adjustment.

methods.name: replace_markdown_links
methods.description: Replaces markdown links in text with original links, adjusting URLs for language.

methods.name: extract_html_links
methods.description: Extracts HTML links from document lines.

methods.name: _construct_html_link
methods.description: Reconstructs HTML link tags with URL adjustments for language.

methods.name: replace_html_links
methods.description: Replaces HTML links in text with original links, adjusting URLs for language.

methods.name: get_code_block_lang
methods.description: Detects language specifier in code fence lines.

methods.name: extract_multiline_code_blocks
methods.description: Extracts multiline code blocks with language and content.

methods.name: _split_hash_comment
methods.description: Splits a line into code and hash-style comment parts.

methods.name: _split_slashes_comment
methods.description: Splits a line into code and slash-style comment parts.

methods.name: replace_multiline_code_block
methods.description: Replaces a code block's content, preserving comments based on language.

methods.name: replace_multiline_code_blocks_in_text
methods.description: Replaces code blocks in text with original code blocks, maintaining comments.

methods.name: check_translation
methods.description: Checks and optionally fixes translation-related inconsistencies in documentation lines.
